about: Lumbridge NPCs. Tiles are the OSRS Wiki's location maps (checked 2026-10-21), which give the tile but not which of a name's types stands there: cows take cow, cow2 and cow3 (ids 2790, 2791, 2793) in turn and calves cow2_calf and cow3_calf (2792, 2794), guessed. Every wander range is guessed (5; the combat tutors 2, as they keep to their hill) until recorded. The combat tutors', shop keepers' and town centre NPCs' tiles are RSMod's rev 233 Lumbridge spawns (the Wiki gives no map for them). Left out of the town: Veos (only here during X Marks the Spot), Barfy Bill (in lumbridge-east.json, with the goblins east of the river), the church's and the farms' NPCs (their own steps), and the Adventure Paths guide, the Deadman and PvP-world NPCs and Aris, whom the cache hides here. The castle's NPCs, Hans among them, are in lumbridge-castle.json.
